instruction: Candid studio close-up photograph against a plain light gray background. On the left, the dark-skinned woman with curly black hair (R1) in a white turtleneck looks down with eyes closed, smiling softly. On the right, the young girl with long straight dark hair (R2) in a beige ribbed top leans her head against the woman's chest, looking at the camera. The woman's hand gently cradles the girl's head. Soft, diffused side lighting creates a warm, tender atmosphere with neutral tones.

R1 provides the chest/upper-body surface that R2 rests against
